component.name: EasyEffects Auto Preset
component.summary: Automated EasyEffects preset switcher for Voice Meetings, YouTube, Music, Movies, and Video

description.p: EasyEffects Auto Preset is an intelligent, context-aware audio preset manager and automatic switcher for EasyEffects on Linux (PipeWire and PulseAudio). Instead of manually switching equalizers and compressors every time you join a work call or play a video, EasyEffects Auto Preset continuously inspects active audio streams in real time and applies the right DSP profile automatically:

ul.li: Voice Meetings (Highest Priority): Automatically switches to a speech-focused preset (such as Compressed-Max or Meeting-Voice-Clear) and optional microphone cleanup preset whenever a voice call or microphone stream is active (Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Discord, Webex, or communication streams).

YouTube, Music, Movies & Video: Automatically switches to a rich media preset (such as Crystal more Bass) whenever YouTube, streaming video (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Twitch, Plex), or any music/movie/video player (Spotify, VLC, mpv, Elisa, Haruna, Celluloid, Kodi, Jellyfin, Rhythmbox) is actively playing sound.
Smart Debouncing: Configurable grace period prevents abrupt preset flapping when pausing tracks, skipping ads, or between speakers in a meeting.

Dual Architecture: Includes both a native, zero-overhead Rust background daemon (<4MB RAM) and a full-featured PyQt6 Settings GUI & System Tray manager with live stream inspection and built-in GitHub Releases update checking.
